steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ summary containing the two bids and original line item.
Enable the required eRFX project setting for the buyer company.
Open the Recreate Order pop-up from the stage Settings menu.
Confirm the requested pop-up is open.
Verify the product section is present.
Assert the product sheet has exactly one line-item row for the original event product.
Verify the mapped product variant is shown.
Verify the original requested quantity and unit are shown.
Verify the original delivery location is shown.
Verify the product sheet includes the Price field.
Verify product-row Details links are available.
Verify the auction configuration section is present.
Assert all expected event-end duration choices are offered.
Verify the 30-minute event-end duration is selected.
Assert all expected evaluation-duration choices are offered.
Verify the 30-minute evaluation duration is selected.
Verify the delivery-date section is present.
Verify the delivery date picker is available.
Verify the scheduling checkbox is present.
Verify the schedule date control is initially greyed out before scheduling is enabled.
Verify the Edit More Details action is present.
Verify the Cancel action is present.
Verify the Create Order action is present.
